name: dusk
prompt: Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset at the same aspect ratio. This is a designed illustration plate: a tilt-shift miniature diorama photograph of an Indian town, shallow depth of field, soft natural light. Keep the same style, lighting, palette, materials, perspective and composition. Remove every piece of UI text, label, caption, button and interface chrome that is not part of the artwork. Remove borders, card corners and drop shadows. Do not add any text, logos or lettering on signs. Do not restyle. The artwork fills the whole frame edge to edge. Remove the headline text and the two buttons in the sky and paint the sky behind them continuously. Paint out every letter on the buildings: every shop signboard is a plain painted board with no writing at all.
